title: StarTrail-org/PixelRAG
claim: StarTrail-org/PixelRAG — The end of web parsing. The beginning of scalable pixel-native search. link: https://pixelrag.ai/
why_good: Skips fragile HTML parsing by doing retrieval directly over rendered pixels — if accurate, it dodges the endless breakage of web scrapers.
value: Sell as an API to teams building agents/search that need reliable web extraction without maintaining parsers; usage-based pricing.
risk: The bold 'end of web parsing' claim needs proof; pixel/vision retrieval is compute-heavy and the big labs chase the same thing.
pick_reason: The project is too vague and lacks a clear monetizable product.

zh.claim: StarTrail-org/PixelRAG —— 网页解析的终结,像素原生搜索的开始。链接:pixelrag.ai
zh.why_good: 跳过脆弱的 HTML 解析,直接在渲染后的像素上做检索——若准确,就绕开了网页爬虫无止境的崩坏。
zh.value: 作为 API 卖给"要可靠网页抽取、又不想维护解析器"的 agent/搜索团队;按量计费。
zh.risk: "网页解析终结"口气很大,需要证据;像素/视觉检索很吃算力,大模型厂商也在追同一件事。
zh.hook: 用检索渲染后的像素取代脆弱的 HTML 爬取——如果准确度站得住的话。

hook: Kills fragile HTML scraping by searching rendered pixels instead — if the accuracy holds up.

voices.quote: …bypasses the idle wait — it needs the same watcher wired into its `_Conn` event loop, and I can't benchmark turbo on this machine (`/dev/shm` + patched headless_shell). The silent fallback is now an explicit log line; turbo idl…
